writing.title: A Mystery Story
writing.prompt_cn: 写一个关于谜团或奇怪事件的短文(如:夜里的怪声、捡到的失物、天空中的怪光)。用情态动词must/might/could/can't表达你的推测。60词左右。
writing.sample: One night, my family heard a strange noise outside. "What could it be?" we asked. My brother thought it might be a cat, but it was too loud. It couldn't be a small animal. "It must be something bigger," said my father. The next morning, we found our rubbish bins open. It must have been a large dog! At last, the mystery was solved, and we all felt relieved.

scoring.content: 含奇怪事件/推测/寻找答案/结果(4分)
